modules.label: Win rate
modules.notes: Dungeon Win Rate is now a Tweak and works on the Dungeon log page itself: a panel above the log shows the win rate, wins and losses since the last 1, 2, 3, 6, 12 or 24 hours, 3 days or all time. Choosing a range that reaches further back loads older entries for you, and Stop cancels it
